capabilities: Set fonts, sizes, colors, spacing and indents per element in a GUI
Pair separate CJK and Latin fonts with real bold faces
Auto-number headings in official-document or thesis style at display time
Apply built-in templates for official documents, theses and reading
Save, switch, import and export style sets, including per-note sets
extras: Desktop only (Obsidian 1.7.2+). Official-document fonts like 方正小标宋 and 仿宋_GB2312 must be installed separately and some are commercial. Styles are display-time only; note content is untouched except an optional cssclasses entry in frontmatter.
problem: Setting Chinese typography (font sizes, first-line indent, heading numbering) in Obsidian normally requires hand-written CSS, which Word users expect from a settings dialog.
summary: Word-like GUI typography plugin for Chinese writing: CJK/Latin font pairing, Chinese font sizes, line spacing, heading numbering, and document templates.
